schema.title: review/pins.yml: review pins, format 1
schema.description: Notes pinned to an object or a place of the map by a person (in the game with `pin <text>`, or in the studio) or an agent, and what became of them: claimed by an agent, resolved with a reply, accepted or reopened by the person. The project's review document, not part of its source: it has its own change counter (`counter`) and its own log (.oymap/pins/log.jsonl), and a pin never changes the source revision. Written by `oymap pins` and the pins methods. A format 0 file (one `reply` text per pin) is read as format 1 and written as format 1 on the next change.

counter.description: One more for every change of this document (a pin added, claimed, answered, accepted ...). The pins' own counter: the map's source revision never moves with it.

pins.description: In the order they were made.

text.description: What the person asks for or points out.

on.description: The object the pin is about: a top-level id (door:gate, room:vault), or a keyed sub-object of one in a file of format 1 (room:hall/pillars/pillar2, room:hall/walls/n/panels/panel1).

file.description: The file of `on` where the id is in more than one file (ids are unique per file: a plan's space and its room share one).

at.description: A place on the map, [x, y, z] in map units, when the pin is about no object.

source.description: Where the pin was made: in the game (`pin <text>`), in the studio, or by an agent.

world.description: The world the map was played in (mm6, mm7, mm8, ...).

map.description: The map file the pin was made on (6d01.blv).

pose.description: Where the person stood and looked, as the game's `loc` prints it (units named in each field, not converted).

position.description: The party's feet, [x, y, z] in map units.

heading_yaw_units.description: The heading in the game's 2048 units (the `goto` command's).

picture.description: The picture made with the pin, relative to the project folder: .oymap/pins/pictures/<pin>.png (outside git), or review/pictures/<pin>.png when kept.

keep.description: The picture is kept in review/pictures/ (in git) on purpose.

author.description: Who made the pin: user, or agent:<name>.

revision.description: The source revision the pin was made against: for a game pin the one the installed map was built from (its <stem>.studio.yml).

lock_hash.description: The hash of the id lock the map was built with.

status.description: open (a pin without one is open), claimed (an agent works on it), resolved (the agent says what it did), accepted (the person agrees), declined (it will not be done).

claimed_by.description: The agent working on the pin (agent:<name>).

from.description: The inbox file a game pin was imported from.

revision.description: The source revision when the reply was written (after the agent's change).

status.description: The status this reply set, if it set one.

pictures.description: Pictures with the reply (the game's after picture), relative to the project folder.
